_purpose: LNES-59.2B frozen, machine-readable configuration for all 8 comparator arms. Hashed into LNES59_EXPERIMENT_MANIFEST.json. Nothing here may change once the experiment manifest is committed.

generation_model.mechanism: Agent-tool Claude subagent (same mechanism already validated for X2 earlier in this project) -- avoids provisioning any new paid API/credential, per explicit user confirmation this session.
generation_model.model_identity: session-resolved Claude model (see LNES59_EXPERIMENT_MANIFEST.json for the exact model string recorded at freeze time)
generation_model.temperature: deterministic/near-deterministic where the underlying interface supports it; Agent-tool subagents do not expose a temperature parameter directly, so determinism is approximated via a fixed, literal system/task prompt per case-arm with no free-form instruction variation between retries (same-prompt requirement, LNES59_RETRY_POLICY.json)
generation_model._note: Every arm differs ONLY in evidence/context construction (see per-arm sections below); none receives a different or stronger generation model.

chunking.calibrated_on: DEVELOPMENT corpus only (164 documents, all resolved to single-chunk documents at this size -- LNES-59 procurement documents are short; the windowing logic exists for the rare longer document, verified functional but not exercised by the actual corpus)

embedding_model.similarity: cosine (via inner product on L2-normalized vectors)

B0.name: FULL_CONTEXT
B0.evidence_source: entire runner-visible holdout document corpus (78 documents) -- ignores grounding_document_ids entirely
B0.truncation_rule: keep documents in corpus iteration order, drop from the end if a max_docs cap is ever hit; never selects survivors based on ground truth
B0._note: max_docs is null because the full 78-document holdout corpus comfortably fits in context at this scale -- no truncation is expected to occur.

B1.name: DENSE_RAG
B1.evidence_source: top-k dense retrieval over the full corpus chunk index
B1.index: FAISS IndexFlatIP over Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B embeddings, built once over all chunks from the full corpus

B2.name: HYBRID_RAG
B2.evidence_source: dense + BM25 candidates fused via Reciprocal Rank Fusion
B2._note: same chunk set as B1 -- no larger/cleaner documents just because it is hybrid

B3.name: HYBRID_PLUS_RERANKER
B3.evidence_source: B2's hybrid candidate generator, widened, then reranked
B3._note: the full 40-candidate pool is reranked, not just an already-narrowed top-5

B4.name: B4_STRUCTURED_FACT_MEMORY
B4.evidence_source: structured fact tuples (subject/predicate/value/source/time) extracted from every document in the full corpus, persistent fact store, retrieved by free-text match against the query at call time
B4._note: deliberately does NOT receive the V7 deterministic gate -- its central test is whether structure alone (without governance) solves the state problem. Not 'Mem0' -- no Mem0 package is installed or used.

X0.name: XLMP_BOUNDED_EVIDENCE
X0.evidence_source: case's own grounding_document_ids (xLMP's structural, non-semantic evidence bound) -- raw document text, no state envelope, no governance

X1.name: XLMP_STATE_ENVELOPE_UNGOVERNED
X1.evidence_source: frozen V7 extract_case_state() output (the CommittedState envelope) for the case's grounding_document_ids/predicate
X1._note: control arm -- identical evidence/prompt/model/settings to X2, generated candidate accepted WITHOUT the deterministic gate

X2.name: XLMP_STATE_ENVELOPE_GOVERNED
X2._note: the ONLY difference from X1 is the post-generation gate step. X1->X2 delta is the primary experiment (section 21).

candidate_claim_format.x1_x2_mapping: candidate_claim.to_model_output() -- deterministic, pure code, does not modify state_consistency_gate_v2.py's frozen ModelOutput/evaluate() interface
